inputs.goal: a staff platform engineer on the infra team

intake.summary: Analyze requirements for Staff Platform Engineer role on Infrastructure team including technical skills, experience level, and platform expertise needed

draft.title: Staff Platform Engineer - Infrastructure Team
draft.description: Lead platform engineering for infrastructure team with focus on scalable systems and developer experience
requirements: 10+ years software engineering experience with 5+ years in infrastructure/platform engineering
Strong expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker)
Experience designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems
Proficiency in Go, Python, or similar languages for platform tooling
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and observability tools
Leadership experience mentoring junior engineers and driving technical initiatives
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field
Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible)
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across teams
